title: Governance Challenges in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: Evaluator Rationality and Reinforcement Stability
findings: The paper did not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus was on evaluator rationality in the RLHF process.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measured the impact of human evaluator rationality on the consistency (Test-Retest Consistency Score) and expert-alignment (Bias Deviation) of feedback for AI-generated answers to rationality questions.
